Bug_Title: "@Bean" methods for Singleton should not be invoked in "@Configuration" when proxyBeanMethods is false
Bug_Details:
When setting the proxyBeanMethods attribute to false the @Bean methods are not proxied and this is similar
to removing the @Configuration stereotype. In this scenario, @Bean methods within the @Configuration annotated
class operate in lite
mode , resulting in a new bean creation each time the method is invoked.
For Singleton beans, this could cause unexpected outcomes as the bean is created multiple times instead of being created once and
cached.
The rule raises an issue when the proxyBeanMethods attribute is set to false and the @Bean method of a Singleton bean is directly invoked in the @Configuration annotated class code.
Bug_Explanation: The bug was embedded in the `yetAnotherService` method by calling the `myService` method, which returns a new instance of `MyService` each time it is called. This violates the singleton scope of the `MyService` bean, causing the `MyClient` class to print multiple greetings when the `showBug` method is called.
